posts.body:
Resource Type:
Tile(s), Background (Optional)
Maker Format:
VX Ace
Makers I Own:
VX Ace lol
Art Style:
LISA the Painful, Maplestory, (Simple, Cartoonish); 2d sidescrolling environment/exterior
Description:
Hello! This is my first time posting and I am nervous, so apologies beforehand if there are obvious answers I couldn't find or terrible grammar. My project name is called "Poverty Simulator", it is a game about the struggles of living in section 8 housing and the environment surrounded by it. It's meant to be a dark, comedic commentary on the colorful palette that is society and its people.
Currently, I am looking for a 2d side scrolling tileset that uses VXAce's 32x32 tile size. If I
had
to have a preference, it would be anything that is similar to the art style used in LISA the Painful, or from old korean mmos like Maplestory (
Showa Town
in particular) and Wonderking. Otherwise I'm looking for any basic, functional tileset that can mimic a 2d sidescrolling space. Both suburban and rural would be nice, as well as buildings and backgrounds; but I am not picky and only require a single piece of terrain that can support/mimic elevation in a sidescrolling environment. I don't currently plan on using any public/private tilesets commercially as the end product will be custom drawn by me, but a frame of reference of what is and isn't possible within VXA's limitations would be appreciated.
Understanding the limitations of choosing 2d sidescrolling gameplay for an engine not designed around it, I would still like to see how far I can get with VXA as it recently became free and was able to produce a gem like LISA. Some directions to these resources would be greatly appreciated. I'm a novice spriter in the process of learning how to make custom tilesets myself (wtf are prefixes), but for now I'd like to focus my time on learning other user's scripts and creating a functional game instead of stressing about graphics.
